title: CHAP: A Hybrid GPU-CPU Heuristic for MIP
summary: We present CHAP (Coordinating Heuristics Across Platforms) a GPU-CPU-hybrid primal heuristic framework for mixed-integer programming. CHAP adopts a portfolio approach where it coordinates a set of primal heuristics, including Local Search, Fix-and-Propagate, and Feasibility Pump, via a shared solution pool. The solution pool is used to exchange feasible incumbent solutions, LP solutions, along with promising infeasible solution candidates, enabling a more comprehensive exploration of the solution space. On the GPU side, we implement a native tabu search featuring a novel best-shift algorithm…
